critical_code_review_comments: quote/new.tsx globalFieldErrors() (L125-135) correctly maps required fields to their inline error keys (name, email, business_name, full_address, postcode, supply_postcode) and includes a proper email regex (/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$/) for the 'Enter a valid email' message.
next() for 'global' step (L144-151) sets fieldErrors, sets a generic banner and scrolls to top on validation failure — matches the requested UX.
Each TextInput's onChangeText calls clearFieldError(key) so the inline error disappears as soon as the user edits that field — confirmed at runtime.
Labeled helper renders the asterisk via styles.req and the error via Text testID={testID} with styles.fieldError (red) — matches the spec.
inputError style (borderWidth:1.5, borderColor:'#DC2626', backgroundColor:'#FEF2F2') is conditionally applied via [styles.input, fieldErrors.X && styles.inputError] on all 5 required inputs.
wizard-next uses navPrimarySubtle (opacity 0.55) when !validateStep(), giving the requested visually-subtle Continue button until the step is valid.
Supply-postcode field is conditionally rendered only when !addr.is_supply_address, and its error clears via clearFieldError('supply_postcode') on change.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: Step 2 showed only a generic banner and did not highlight invalid fields. RCA: previous validateStep() computed only a boolean and next() surfaced a single banner. Fix (already implemented in /app/frontend/app/quote/new.tsx): a new globalFieldErrors() function returns a Record<string,string> of per-field messages; next() writes it to fieldErrors state, which drives (a) the red input border via styles.inputError, (b) the red inline Text under each field via Labeled(testID=...), (c) mandatory-label asterisks via required prop, and (d) auto-scroll to top with scrollRef. Each input's onChangeText also calls clearFieldError() so errors self-clear when the user starts editing. Verified end-to-end on preview; no regressions observed.
